items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: A boy called Anderson... Davis played first trumpet... Anderson, he was the second trumpet player

ctx.x: So who were the trumpets in the big band?

A boy called Anderson, and then a little boy called Davis (I can't think of his last name)...and who was the other trumpet player...? I forget the other trumpet player. Who was that other boy played trumpet...?
Which one of them took the solos? Who was the sort of get-off man of that lot?
